semantic_spine.literal_event: Paramedics perform emergency chest compressions on a waterlogged swimmer pulled onto the beach until the swimmer coughs up seawater and starts breathing.
semantic_spine.semantic_focus: The physical resuscitation of an unresponsive drowning victim leading directly to the sudden physiological return of respiration.
semantic_spine.emotional_relation: High-urgency mechanical intervention transitioning into critical relief as vital function resumes.
semantic_spine.memory_hook: Rhythmic downward chest displacement under locked wrists yielding a violent, seawater-expelling cough.

metaphor.literal_anchor: paramedics applying rhythmic resuscitation compressions until the waterlogged swimmer coughs and breathes

special_device.reason: The four sequential shots provide complete, legible cinematic progression from setting to tactile intervention to payoff without requiring physical gutter breakouts.

page_design.eye_flow_summary: The gaze descends from the beach overview in panel 1 down to the coordinated responders in panel 2, concentrates on the tight chest compression contact in panel 3, and releases into the expansive lateral convulsion of the revived swimmer in panel 4.
